title: Colts CB Cam Taylor-Britt suspended 1 game for violating NFL's personal conduct policy, will sit out Week 1

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts CB Cam Taylor-Britt suspended 1 game for violating NFL's personal conduct policy, will sit out Week 1
sources.description: The suspension dates to a September 2025 arrest for reckless driving and driving without a license in Cincinnati while Taylor-Britt played for the Bengals.
